verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says whether meeting data is used to train AI models. It documents no opt-out from model training and mentions no SOC 2 or HIPAA attestation. Retention policies (including zero-day retention), org-wide recording policies, transcript redaction and Super Admin deletion are related privacy controls, not the training-use disclosure, opt-out or compliance posture this story asks for. The phrase "enterprise-grade security" is too vague to count.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
